name: webeep

description: Browse your Politecnico di Milano WeBeep (Moodle) courses: materials, recordings, announcements, notifications and deadlines

preferences.name: sessionCookie
preferences.title: MoodleSession Cookie
preferences.description: Value of the MoodleSession cookie of webeep.polimi.it, copied from your browser after logging in (see the README for the steps). You paste it only once: it is exchanged for a Moodle token that stays valid for about three months.

preferences.title: Content Language

preferences.title: Download Directory
preferences.description: Folder where course files are saved (defaults to ~/Downloads)
